mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AI search optimization for a legal practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seeing results from AI search optimization for a legal practice typically takes several months, not weeks. Initial improvements in rankings and organic traffic can often be observed within 3-6 months. However, significant and sustained growth, especially for competitive legal terms, usually requires 6-12 months of consistent effort. AI tools accelerate the optimization process, but search engine algorithms still need time to re-evaluate and re-index websites based on the changes implemented.
